resources.string: This agreement governs the enterprise messaging service between you and the XingDun IM operator. The legal operator is identified in the About page, official website, or enterprise notice. A development build is not a public commercial-service commitment.

string-array.name: xingdun_user_agreement_sections
string-array.item: 1. Acceptance and scope

Read this agreement, the Privacy Policy, Account Deactivation Rules, and Minor and Sensitive Information Rules before registering, signing in, or using the service. Agreeing, completing registration or sign-in, or using the service means you understand and accept them. Enterprise members must also follow this agreement; internal rules cannot remove statutory personal-information rights.
2. Service and boundaries

XingDun IM provides enterprise accounts, direct and group chat, contacts, media and file transfer, search, read receipts, favorites, calls, offline notifications, workbench, reports, feedback, and enterprise management. Availability depends on the version, enterprise configuration, account permissions, and region. Camera, microphone, media, and notification access is requested only when needed.
3. Account and enterprise security

• Provide accurate information you are authorized to use and do not impersonate another person or organization.
• Do not rent, sell, transfer, or share accounts, passwords, verification codes, or credentials.
• Protect devices and credentials and respond promptly to suspicious access.
• Authorized enterprise administrators may manage members, departments, groups, workbench access, security policies, and account status.
4. Content and conduct

You are responsible for text, images, audio, video, location, files, and other content you send or share. Do not publish unlawful material, infringe privacy or intellectual property, disclose trade secrets, harass, defraud, gamble, distribute malware, attack systems, bypass security controls, scrape data without authorization, or misuse personal information. Use reporting and support channels for suspected violations.
5. Governance and enforcement

To meet safety and compliance duties, the platform and authorized enterprise administrators may verify reports, public profile data, and necessary communication evidence, then apply warnings, restrictions, mute controls, content removal, forced sign-out, suspension, or termination. Except for urgent risks or legal requirements, actions are based on traceable records and may be appealed through support.
6. Enterprise management and data responsibility

When an enterprise independently determines how member information is processed for personnel, collaboration, or compliance purposes, it must provide notices, obtain required authorization, and maintain security. Leaving or changing roles may alter access to contacts, groups, workbench data, and enterprise history, but does not automatically delete messages lawfully received by others.
7. Intellectual property

XingDun IM software, interfaces, brands, documents, and platform content are protected by law. Without written authorization, do not copy, reverse engineer, rent, sell, adapt, or use them for unrelated commercial purposes. You retain rights in your own content and grant only the limited processing rights required to transmit, store, display, back up, secure, and troubleshoot it.
8. Third-party infrastructure

Messaging, offline push, calls, system notifications, and image loading rely on Tencent Cloud, Android platform services, device vendors, and open-source components. Their availability may change with systems, networks, policies, or versions. Providers, purposes, and data boundaries are described in the Privacy Policy and third-party SDK disclosure.
9. Changes, interruption, and liability

Features may change or pause for maintenance, security incidents, regulatory requirements, or third-party changes, with notice where reasonably possible. Liability for network, device, force majeure, third-party, or user-caused loss follows applicable law and fault; nothing here excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.
10. Sign-out, withdrawal, and deactivation

Sign-out ends only the current session. Withdrawing privacy consent stops client services that depend on the relevant processing. Account deactivation disables the business account and all devices and begins controlled recovery and deletion. These actions have different legal and data effects. Deactivation is available under My - Settings - Account and Security.
11. Protection of minors
The initial service is only for enterprise or organization members aged 18 or older. Minors must not register or use the service.
12. Law, disputes, and contact

Mainland China law applies. Disputes should first be resolved through consultation and may then be submitted to a court with jurisdiction. Use My - Help and Feedback for inquiries, complaints, appeals, or personal-information rights requests. Material agreement changes will update the version and seek confirmation as required.

resources.string: This policy explains the personal information processed to provide enterprise messaging, its purposes and methods, retention, third-party services, and your rights. We follow purpose limitation, data minimization, transparency, and security principles.

string-array.name: xingdun_privacy_policy_sections
string-array.item: 1. Scope and roles

This policy applies to the XingDun IM Android client and supporting services. The operator is responsible for product accounts, core communication capabilities, and platform security. An enterprise that independently determines member-data processing for personnel or internal management must fulfill its own legal duties. Refusing an optional permission does not disable unrelated basic functions.
2. Account, profile, and enterprise relationship

• Account identifiers: username, user ID, Tencent UserID, enterprise code, and optional phone or email.
• Profile: nickname, avatar, signature, gender, birthday, department, and information you provide.
• Authentication: password hash, business credentials, UserSig, and credential version; sensitive local credentials use encrypted storage backed by Android Keystore.
• Enterprise relationships: enterprise, department, role, friends, blocks, groups, and customer-service relationships.
3. Communications and user content

When you use chat, groups, location, inactive red-packet compatibility, calls, workbench, feedback, or reports, we process the content and metadata necessary for transmission, synchronization, display, receipts, favorites, search, security review, dispute handling, and troubleshooting. Recipients and authorized enterprise members may view sent content. Local deletion does not necessarily delete copies already received or records retained by law.
4. Device, network, and logs

• Device model, operating system, app version, application ID, language, and network state support compatibility and routing.
• IP address, request time, API result, login and device status, crash and error logs support security, audit, and troubleshooting.
• TIMPush and vendor-channel registration identifiers support offline messages and incoming-call notifications and are not used for advertising.
• Logs minimize data and redact passwords, UserSig, JWT, phone numbers, and similar secrets.
5. System permissions and local capabilities

Notifications support messages, calls, and business alerts. Camera and microphone support chat media, voice recording, and calls. Photos and media support selecting or saving chat media; the system picker limits file access to your selection. Permissions are requested only when the related feature is used and may be disabled in Android system settings.
6. Purposes and legal bases

Information is processed to perform the user agreement; provide registration, enterprise management, messaging, calls, notifications, and collaboration; operate optional permissions or sensitive functions with required consent; meet legal and security duties; handle abuse, reports, disputes, and regulatory requests; and protect life, health, or property in emergencies where law permits.
7. Processors, sharing, and third-party SDKs

Core capabilities use Tencent Cloud IM, TIMPush, Tencent RTC and call components, Android platform services, device-vendor push, and local or resource-based open-source components. They process only function-related user identifiers, device and network information, message-transfer data, push identifiers, media streams, and minimal call routing. Call recording is disabled. Secrets and UserSig are not placed in notification payloads. We do not sell personal information or disclose it to unrelated parties.
8. Storage location and retention

Personal information collected in mainland China is generally stored there. Cross-border transfers, if later required, will follow notice, consent, and legal procedures. Account and enterprise data remain while the account is active and during deactivation processing; messaging, collaboration, security, login, and operation records follow enterprise configuration, service rules, legal duties, and dispute needs. Expired data is deleted or anonymized.
9. Security and incident response

We use transport protection, access control, credential isolation, Android Keystore-backed encrypted storage, log redaction, permission separation, and auditing. Tencent SecretKey and callback secrets do not enter the Android client; UserSig is issued by the server for the session. Security incidents are contained and reported as required, including impact and remediation information.
10. Your rights

You may use profile, device management, privacy and agreement, messaging, and account-security controls to access, correct, copy, or delete applicable information, withdraw consent, manage permissions, and request account deactivation. Requests that cannot be completed directly may be submitted through My - Help and Feedback. Identity may be verified, and lawful limits involving others, enterprise duties, or mandatory retention will be explained.
11. Consent withdrawal and account deactivation

Withdrawal does not invalidate processing already performed with consent. After withdrawal, the client signs out of messaging, stops notification registration, and clears the local session; consent is required before using the service again. Account deactivation separately disables every device and begins controlled recovery and deletion. Messages received by others, enterprise records, and legally retained data are not automatically deleted.
12. Minors and sensitive information

XingDun IM is initially limited to enterprise members aged 18 or older and does not accept minors. If minor data is collected by mistake, the account will be restricted and the data deleted or anonymized as required. Identity, financial, precise location, health, biometric, and other sensitive information requires a specific purpose, strict necessity, enhanced safeguards, and separate consent where required.
13. Updates and contact

Material changes to purposes, information types, third-party services, or rights methods update this policy version and seek consent as required. The current version and consent record are available under My - Privacy and Agreements. Use My - Help and Feedback for privacy inquiries, complaints, deletion, deactivation, or minor-protection requests. The legal operator and formal contact details are published in About, the official website, or enterprise notices.
